## Description

Models fair futures value from spot index, financing, expected dividends and time to expiry; trades deviations after costs and hedge constraints.

## Where it may fit

Temporary futures-versus-cash dislocations, especially around expiry, financing changes or dividend expectations.

## Vehicles

Equity-index arbitrage, index futures funds, institutional trading desks.

## Required data

Index futures and constituent/ETF prices, rates, dividend forecasts, expiry calendars, market depth, financing and transaction costs.

## Caveats

Index cash baskets are costly to replicate; use executable prices and include dividend forecast error, funding, taxes and execution latency.
